name: @red-cup-engineering/semiotic-voxel-package-installation-assay-service
description: Proves that registry packages install and retain complete executable faces in isolated customer territories.

scripts.verify: node --check src/assay-package-installation.mjs && node --check bin/assay-package-installation.mjs && node --test test/*.test.mjs

assay-package-installation.accepts: one immutable registry receipt, npm client configuration, package selection, and bounded parallelism
assay-package-installation.returns: one customer-territory installation receipt or exact per-package defects
